player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Bathroom, Exercise room, Media room, and Craft room, repeatedly traversing the same edges without ever exploring the unvisited "south" direction available in the Media room. My strategy failed because I blindly followed the first available direction instead of systematically tracking visited rooms and prioritizing unexplored paths. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms; whenever I enter a room with multiple available directions, I will explicitly check if any direction leads to an unvisited room before moving. Specifically, in the Media room, I should have chosen "south" immediately upon arrival to break the cycle and reach the Solarium.
